summary: Sends camera tracking channels to external devices or software as FreeD D1 camera position and orientation packets once per frame.
key_concepts: Sends camera tracking position and orientation to external software or devices over the device-independent FreeD protocol.
Emits one FreeD packet per frame based on the current input CHOP channels, using default values for expected channels that are missing.
Expected channels are camera_id, tx, ty, tz, rx, ry, rz, focus, zoom, and user.
The operator sends the FreeD D1 camera position and orientation message, with documented position and rotation encoding limits.
Network Address can target a domain, IP address, or localhost; Local Address selects the sending NIC on multi-adapter systems.

key_params.name: protocol
key_params.note: Network protocol, such as UDP messaging or multicast

key_params.name: netaddress
key_params.note: Destination host, IP, domain, or localhost

key_params.name: localaddress
key_params.note: Local NIC/IP address to send from

common_gotchas: The CHOP sends one packet per frame from the current input channels.
Expected channels include camera_id, tx, ty, tz, rx, ry, rz, focus, zoom, and user; missing channels use defaults.
FreeD position and rotation ranges are limited by the D1 protocol encoding.
Focus and zoom are arbitrary hardware-dependent 24-bit units.
Use explicit destination and local addresses on multi-NIC show networks.
